enAudit: G2-292 shopping-math-three-things — RESOLVED upstream (kinds is now ["total3","total3","total3"], verified with loadType). Recorded for the trail: it shipped as ["total3","total","total3"], so the middle card held only TWO items while the title promised three; the render g2292-fruits.png card 2 read "Emma puts mango and kiwi in the basket". pt copy has been rewritten to the uniform page ("três produtos" / "some os três preços de cada uma das cestas") and the earlier hedged wording is gone.

G2-294 shopping-math-is-there-enough-money — the instruction 'Count the coins, then compare them with the price' describes a control the page does not have. The canBuy frame in G2-276 renders the money as a NUMBER ({name} tem {money}); coins are drawn only by the 'change' kind, and the render (g2294-vehicles.png) shows no coins at all. Either the instruction should say 'read how much money there is', or the canBuy kind should draw coins.

G2-295 shopping-math-how-much-more — RESOLVED upstream (kinds is now ["diff","diff","diff"], verified with loadType). Recorded for the trail: it shipped as ["diff","total","diff"], so card 2 asked for a TOTAL under a title promising a difference (render g2295-toys.png card 2). pt copy now says the difference on every card.

G1-283 sentence-building no-clues — the sentence-frame pool applies animate verbs to inanimate theme nouns. Render g1283-vehicles.png lane 4 is 'feeds / tom / skateboard / the', i.e. 'tom feeds the skateboard'. A first-grader asked to find 'the only order that works' cannot, because the only grammatical order is semantically nonsense. The frames need an animacy gate before the vehicles/toys themes, exactly like the PERSON_KEYS filter already used in G2-276.

G1-282 / G1-283 sentence-building — ⭐ NAMING A SPECIFIC END MARK IS WRONG ON MOST PAGES OF THIS FAMILY. The English G1-282 instruction says 'The capital letter and the FULL STOP show you where the sentence starts and ends', but the unscramble frame pool contains questions (pt: 2 of the 12 frames carry '?', and with 3 lanes drawn from 12 the chance a page contains one is ~45%; the fr panel measured 30 of 40 deck variants). The very first sweep render, g1282-fruits.png, opens with 'Is this your pomegranate?' — so the shipped EN instruction is already false on the page it was rendered from. Both faces need a generic end-mark word ('the end mark'), not 'full stop'. pt now says 'o sinal final' on both. G2-281 is the ONE face where a specific mark is correct, because its spec pins ends:['.'].

G2-282 capitals-punctuation choose-the-end-mark — the difficulty carries needCaps:3 and the page prints a legend chip 'Names', but the instruction mentions only end marks. A child who follows the instruction leaves 'lily and i like the nectarine' with a lowercase name and a lowercase 'i' and is still marked wrong. The instruction should name the proper-noun capital that the page's own legend advertises.

G1-271 doubles-and-halves-to-20 — the instruction opens 'There are no pictures this time', but every card carries a dot-grid working panel (render g1271-vehicles.png). 'No pictures' reads to a six-year-old as 'nothing to look at'; the true difference is that there are no COUNTERS to count, so the numbers must be worked from. Suggest 'No counters this time — work each double and half out from the numbers.'

K-289 word-tracing first-words — this is the only word-tracing face with caption:false, so the model word sits ON the writing lane rather than under the picture, and there is exactly ONE empty lane after the trace (K-290/K-291 have two). The instruction says 'write the word on the empty lines', plural, which over-promises the space. Minor, but it is the one face in the family whose lane structure differs.

G1-263 alphabetical-order-four-words — the title 'ABC Order: Four Words' names the card count, which is the one property it does NOT differ on: G1-262 also has cards:4. The real difference is rulings:true vs rulings:false, i.e. G1-263 also copies the words onto lines. Two sibling faces where the title names a shared property and hides the distinguishing one; a searcher cannot tell them apart.

G2-281 capitals-punctuation — RESOLVED upstream, recorded for the trail: this face used to be ends:["."] with a generic "End mark" legend chip, and I cleared "full stop" as honest on that basis. It is now lanes:3 / needCaps:0 / ends:[".","?"] / needQ:1, so a question is GUARANTEED on every page and the concrete mark is wrong here too. pt now uses the generic "sinal final" on all three capitals-punctuation/sentence-building faces (G1-282, G1-283, G2-281). LESSON WORTH KEEPING: an honesty clearance is only valid against the spec at the moment it was checked — re-read loadType() rather than trusting a previous round's verdict, and note the sweep PNG for this face is STALE (it predates the widening).

G3-373 division-word-problems-grouping — the instruction says 'Ring the groups in the picture, then write the answer', but unlike the sharing faces (G3-372, G3-374 card 1) this face draws NO dashed group boxes: the items sit in one plain strip (render g3373-toys.png). The child is being asked to draw the rings freehand, which is fine, but the instruction reads as though the rings are already there to be traced. Worth one word: 'Draw a ring round each group.'

NOT a defect, checked and cleared (recording so the next panel does not re-file them): G3-376 story 2 really does show 30 cranes (3 rows of 10) against six boxes; G1-252 declares colors:8 but correctly renders 6, because colorKeys slices the palette down to the card count; G1-264 really does contain two same-first-letter pairs (pairs:2 is enforced by the generator, so it holds per locale, not only in English).

⭐ STANDING LESSON from three rounds of late spec changes (G2-281 ends widened, G2-292/G2-295 kinds made uniform, G2-297 cut to five questions and sixRows:false): COPY THAT NAMES A COUNT OR A MARK IS A CLAIM ABOUT THE SPEC, NOT ABOUT THE PAGE I SAW. Every one of these was caught by re-reading loadType(id).difficulty[2], and in each case the sweep PNG was stale and would have led me wrong. Before shipping any locale of this batch, re-read the specs for the faces whose copy names a quantity (cards, lanes, questions, markings, price counts) or a punctuation mark — those are the only fields that go false when a spec moves.
